_about: The federal periods of war, for the war memorial's section headings (Nathan, 4 October 2026: each war section gets its dates). Read from 38 CFR 3.2, saved in inventory/sources/periods-of-war-2026-10-04/ (sha256 767e161fe870b66a5a9abee8a32d8de1051061753b53158ca26ccc02ca94cdca). These are the dates of service the law counts, not the dates of the fighting.
source: Periods of war, 38 CFR 3.2 (Electronic Code of Federal Regulations), as published by the Legal Information Institute, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/38/3.2, read 4 October 2026.

conflicts.Vietnam War: August 5, 1964, to May 7, 1975 (from November 1, 1955, for service in Vietnam itself)
conflicts.War on Terror: no period of its own; its service falls in the Persian Gulf War period, open since August 2, 1990
